snippet.title: Voltus' Neon Nightmare 2 (Colossal Cure) - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4882170/Voltus_Neon_Nightmare__Colossal_Cure/?beta=0

This game will cost 5€ and will only be downloadable on Steam.

DOWNLOAD VOLTUS' NEON NIGHTMARE CHAPTER 1 HERE :

https://gamejolt.com/games/grinveil_voltus_chapter_1/975477

If you're into both liminal spaces and mascot horror games, this is the perfect game for you.

After the events of the first chapter, you realized that this "mall" place was a trap to send you to another dimension, full of liminal and unknown places. Voltus is now controlled by the Core's energy, forced to keep you away from it. You'll have to find a way to escape from your cage, and with the help you'll find on your way to the Core itself, you'll have to cure Voltus from his madness, so there will no longer be any obstacle between you and the Core.

The Core is an unlimited source of energy, so powerful that it could either save or destroy the entire planet. Finding the Core is essential to the world's future, as we need a new source of energy for humanity, to keep our world safe from any danger.

Explore liminal spaces, meet new friends and enemies, find the Core, and escape this endless world of chaos.
